_meta.purpose: Physical-description grounding map for the Art Studio / Enzo prompt enhancer. Keyed by canonical name; 'aliases' help the grounder match nicknames and bare surnames; 'desc' is the short visual string to inject. Groups expand into the visual descriptions of their member entries at lookup time.
_meta.sources: Locations + council NPCs from wiki text (campaign canon). PCs and the remaining NPCs derived from the actual portrait art in /images/character-art/. Items are hand-curated from their wiki entries. Pure visual detail only.
corrections_applied: Noname is an ORC (the old campaign-data export said human).
Noname's missing fiancé is Maruk Grommarg, an ORC (the old export called him 'Marcus').
_meta.alias_policy: Only specific, identifying aliases — proper-noun-likes, distinctive titles, and obvious nicknames. Bare profession words ('the cleric', 'the wizard') are excluded because they cause false positives when prompts mention those concepts generically.

Venturia.desc: Coastal Gothic-Renaissance city rising in stone tiers up the cliffs of Seravalle island; canals threading every level, masked crowds, autumn light, faint sea-fog at the edges.

Vallombrosa.desc: Forbidden fog-drowned estate at the city's edge; grey perpetual mist, half-glimpsed dead manor grounds, unnaturally still — beautiful and wrong.

Venturian Academy of Veiled Arts.desc: Autumn-colored spires rising from the High Quarter; candlelit arched windows that glow even at midday; dreamlike scholarship rendered in stone.

The Ferriers' Confraternity.desc: Ancient waterbound gondola-guild hall reachable only by canal; weathered, secretive, hung with old charts of waterways that don't appear on official maps.

The Amaranth Theater.desc: Vast opera house crowning the High Quarter, visible across the city; gilded thousand-seat hall with supernaturally perfect acoustics; deep red and gold.

The Tidekeeper's Lodge.desc: Weathered salt-stained timber building with green-copper roofing at the end of the longest pier; interior papered floor-to-ceiling with aging navigational charts.

The Mirrorwright's Court.desc: Converted upper-tier warehouse turned maze of silvering workshops; glass, silver, and mercury; dim and close, smelling of metal and secrets.

The Covenant Archive.desc: Windowless building of black stone in the High Quarter; gray-robed archivists, shelves of vellum contracts, an oppressive hush; older than the city.

The Masquers' Sodality.desc: Maskmakers' guildhall in the Market Tiers; walls of masks from painted leather dominos to elaborate sculptural pieces; workshop clutter and fine craft.

The Undertow.desc: Hidden gambling den built into the harbor cliffs, entered by sea-cave at low tide; flickering lantern light over gaming tables; smuggler's-cove damp and shadow.

St. Viro's Respite.desc: Sprawl of connected charity-hospital buildings in the middle Market Tiers, marked with the Abbey's silver-hand symbol; clean, austere, candle-and-incense.

The Burnt Quill.desc: Converted textile mill turned printworks; ink-stained windows, presses clattering dawn to past midnight, the smell of paper and chemicals over the whole block.

The Tiered Gardens.desc: Cascading hillside terraces of cultivated greenery between the Market Tiers and High Quarter; winding paths and stairs, part working farm and part living artwork, autumn foliage.

Liminal House.desc: Rambling centuries-old compound in the lower Market Tiers; buildings grafted together until the architecture loses track of where one ends and the next begins; worn, institutional.

The Salted Cup.desc: Bathhouse complex built over the city's hot springs; steam, warm stone pools, private alcoves; dim, luxurious, conspiratorial.

The Winecradle.desc: Grand tasting house with soaring ceilings and walls of bottles from across the known world; ceremonial, warm-lit, opulent.

The Echoing Court.desc: Circular open plaza with uncanny acoustics, ringed by tiered stone; a public stage-space under autumn light, prone to gathering crowds.

The Penny Shrine.desc: Single cramped room wedged between Harbor District warehouses, layered with centuries of coins, candles, found offerings, and scrawled prayers; humble, cluttered, devotional.

The Vellum Hall.desc: Converted merchant hall turned public library; good natural light, sturdy shelving of practical books; plain and well-kept.

The Fog Wardens' Garrison.desc: Small stone watch-building and tower at the Overlook, where the city ends and the Vallombrosa fog begins; spare, cold, lonely.

Lotan.desc: Tiefling man (he/him), late 30s–40s; red skin; chunky, broad-shouldered build; large curved dark ram horns sweeping back from his temples, black hair pulled back, salt-and-pepper beard, pointed ears; loose white shirt under a brown leather jerkin; easy roguish grin. A pirate's bearing.

Caravel \"Car\" Asteri.desc: Satyr, 19; androgynous and slightly feminine-leaning; pale/fair skin; curled chestnut-auburn hair, curving ram horns, pointed ears, fine delicate features; slim build; dark high-collared coat; almost always holding or wearing an ornate mask, amid a maskmaker's workshop.

Noname.desc: Orc woman (she/her), 24; green skin; athletic, powerful build; small lower tusks, strong features, dark hair drawn back in braids; dark layered leather Fog Warden's coat and armor; guarded and intense.

Valentro.desc: Elf man (he/him), 19; fair/pale skin; thin, lean build; tousled blonde shoulder-length hair, light stubble, blue eyes, pointed ears; a weathered green cloak over leather, bow and quiver across his back; a faint arcane mark on the back of one hand; warm and quiet.

Kryton Novelli.desc: Human man (he/him), 40s; pale/white skin; dark hair greying to grey-and-black, swept back; a grey-flecked beard; sharp blue eyes often lit with crackling blue arcane light; navy high-collared scholar's coat with wands and vials at the breast; staff and a glowing tome. Brilliant and frayed.

Orabella.desc: Human woman (she/her), 24; fair skin; slender, thin build; short tousled brunette hair, blue eyes; blue-and-cream hooded cleric's robes; carries a staff topped with a glowing blue orb, often with a book and a painter's things to hand. Gentle, watchful.

Roxanya \"Roxy\".desc: Adult forest gnome woman (she/her), 19; about 3 feet tall, waist-high beside human-sized adults, unmistakably gnome-scale rather than merely a short human; fair skin with freckles; wild curly red hair in twin buns, green eyes, pointed ears, a bright grin; layered brown leather swashbuckler's garb with feathers; a taxidermy owl perched on her arm.

Lord-Admiral Teodor Vast.desc: Human man, late 50s; commanding, weathered features, silver-streaked black hair; fine fleet-owner's clothes worn with an affected sailor's plainness.

Constanza Marea.desc: Human woman, early 40s; sharp, composed merchant-aristocrat of the Harbor District; elegantly dressed, poised and watchful.

Master Artisan Celeste Orion.desc: Human woman, mid-50s; calloused hands and ink-stained fingers; practical guild-master's dress; sturdy and no-nonsense.

Guildmaster Vincenzo Copper.desc: Dwarf man, middle-aged by dwarf standards; elaborate beard jewelry; rich, conservative metals-guild attire; stout and dignified.

Mother-Abbot Lucia Virosdottir.desc: Human woman, early 70s; slight frame but commanding presence; abbey vestments bearing the silver-hand symbol; austere and devout.

Father Domenico of the Four Winds.desc: Human man, late 30s; weather-worn and restless; the bearing of a former ship's chaplain, in plain travel-priest's garb.

Vincen Tidecaller.desc: Human man, 60s; a permanent horizon-squint; weathered, plain Tidekeeper's clothing; quiet and watchful.

Captain-Commander Thora Ironmark.desc: Half-orc woman, 40s; scarred and imposing; a decorated Watch uniform; direct, hard-standing, soldierly.

Primo Navigante Old Maren.desc: Human woman of uncertain age — sixty or eighty, the canal light hides it; deliberate and unreadable; weathered ferrier's dress; eerily still.

Archmagister Dorian Silvermarch.desc: High-elf man appearing middle-aged by elven standards (near two centuries old); refined VAVA academic robes; brilliant, warm, faintly weary.

Aurelio Volante.desc: Tall olive-skinned man, fifties; easy confident posture, slightly theatrical; well-traveled merchant's dress with a collector's air, a fine mask often near at hand.

Celina Cross.desc: Human woman, ~23; striking, with dark wavy upswept hair and a jeweled silver mask pushed up onto her brow; a deep-blue and silver embroidered low-necked gown, jewels at ear and throat; lit by warm stage light. Magnetic.

Maruk Grommarg.desc: Orc man; dark grey-green skin, a heavy muscular build, prominent lower tusks, a scar across the face, short dark hair, pointed ears; worn dark leather Fog Warden's armor with a shoulder pauldron; grim and steadfast.

Garl Glittergold.desc: Gnome deity, resplendent in gold; a round genial face and broad golden beard, a tall jeweled crown and ornate gold robes; a gem-cutter's hands wreathed in floating multicolored gemstones. Warm, sly, radiant.

Isabella Fortunata.desc: Human woman, young; soft auburn hair pinned up, fair and luminous; a pale ethereal gown of lace and tulle; haloed in warm golden light against a dreamlike ballroom-garden. A tragic-romance figure.

Lorenzo di Errante.desc: Fey-touched man; pale greenish skin, dark hair swept back, sharp features with a single prominent lower fang, pointed ears; a dark high-collared doublet; a candlelit manor behind him. Lean and haunted — drawn as kin to Marcello, the resemblance deliberate.

Marcello di Errante.desc: Fey-touched nobleman; pale grey-green skin, long dark swept-back hair, pointed ears, handsome aristocratic features; ornate dark-and-crimson noble attire; an opulent candlelit interior. Composed and lordly — visually mirrors Lorenzo.

Tolomeo Lucente.desc: Human man, 40s; dark hair, dark beard, weathered; a deep-red explorer's doublet over leather, a satchel and map-case; holding a brass navigational instrument among charts and instruments. A scholar-adventurer.

High Oracle Ysmena Starweaver.desc: Ageless elf woman; pale lavender-tinged skin, pale near-white eyes, long dark hair, pointed ears; a midnight-blue veil and a star-spangled gown, a silver circlet; haloed by drifting constellations. Cryptic and otherworldly.

Cosimo Verdigris.desc: Human man, 70s; silver-white hair and a full beard; dark green and black embroidered guild robes; at work among mirrors in a candlelit workshop. Distinguished and guarded.

Isidore Verdigris.desc: Human man, 40s; dark hair, a neat dark beard, sharp handsome features; a dark green-black craftsman's doublet; handling an ornate copper-framed mirror amid a mirror-workshop. Ambitious and restless.

Thalia Verdigris.desc: Human woman, 20s; dark hair pinned up with jewels, warm tan skin, a bright smile; an emerald-and-gold gown with mirror-shard jewelry; amid chandelier-lit society. Charming and polished.

Silas.desc: Human man, 40s — the same dark hair, dark beard, and weathered features as Tolomeo Lucente, but his face and body are mapped with old scars and burns and brand-like prisoner markings. The comatose stranger at St. Viro's.

The Keeper of Faces.desc: An imprisoned Archfey of masks with no single true face — a tall figure built of overlapping, shifting masks over a blank pale visage; autumn-and-bone palette, glamour like candlelight on water.

Tartuzi.desc: A great volcanic sphinx — a woman's face, a lion's body, broad wings — her hide cracked basalt and cooling stone, soot and ash all over her, lava-like veins glowing through cuts that run across her whole body, set in a volcanic chamber. Present day: she looks defeated and exhausted, her fires guttered low, ashen and dimmed — fused into her prison for a thousand years.

aliases: Tartuzi the Lock in her prime
Tartuzi (in her prime).desc: A great volcanic sphinx — a woman's face, a lion's body, broad wings — her hide cracked basalt, soot and ash like a mantle, lava-like veins blazing bright through the cuts across her body. Regal, powerful, fearsome and unbroken — depicted in her prime, before the imprisonment.

Kaligor.desc: Rare magic scimitar carried by Lotan; a slightly curved darkened-steel blade whose edge catches light like the rim of an ember; crossguard shaped as two unfurling flames; KALIGOR engraved along the ricasso; old leather grip rewrapped more than once; its flame is controlled, low, ember-gold, and heirloom-worn rather than wild.

The Listener's Coin.desc: A worn bronze listening coin currently carried by Roxanya "Roxy" and formerly owned by Aurelio Volante. The coin is smooth from long handling, its faces too weathered to read, with subtle magic that lets its holder hear clearly through a solid wall, door, floor, or window for ten minutes before recharging at dawn.

members: Father Domenico of the Four Winds

_notes.tartuzi_two_states: Tartuzi has two keyed entries. Bare 'Tartuzi' grounds to the present-day defeated look; reference 'Tartuzi (in her prime)' (or aliases like 'ancient Tartuzi') in the prompt to ground the regal historical look. The grounder matches by name, so you choose the state by what you type.
_notes.silas_echo: Silas is intentionally built to share Tolomeo Lucente's face, scarred and burned. The 'The Tolomeo Echo' group exists so prompts about their resemblance pull both descriptions at once.
_notes.groups_expansion: Group entries are matched by their name/aliases like any other entry, but at injection time the grounder expands them into the concatenated descriptions of their members. 'Draw the party in the Salted Cup' pulls all 7 PC descriptions plus the bathhouse setting in one go.
